title: validateCreate doc comment contradicts behaviour (says all four fields required)
evidence: src/app.ts:28 comment 'All of title/author/year/isbn must be present' but src/app.ts:46-51 treat year/isbn as optional (and tests/books.test.ts:63 asserts they may be omitted)
suggestion: Change the comment to 'title and author required; year and isbn optional'

title: ?author= filter is exact, case-sensitive match
evidence: src/app.ts:183 'WHERE author = ?' — 'tolkien' will not match 'J.R.R. Tolkien'
suggestion: Optionally use COLLATE NOCASE or LIKE for a friendlier filter; spec does not require it

title: PUT checks existence before validating the body
evidence: src/app.ts:208-216 — invalid body against a missing id returns 404 rather than 400
suggestion: Acceptable either way; validate first if 400 precedence is preferred
